title: On Data-Driven Koopman Representations of Nonlinear Delay Differential Equations
abstract: arXiv:2604.03086v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This work establishes a rigorous bridge between infinite-dimensional delay dynamics and finite-dimensional Koopman learning, with explicit and interpretable error guarantees. While Koopman analysis is well-developed for ordinary differential equations (ODEs) and partially for partial differential equations (PDEs), its extension to delay differential equations (DDEs) remains limited due to the infinite-dimensional phase space of DDEs. We propose a finite-dimensional Koopman approximation framework based on history discretization and a suitable reconstruction operator, enabling a tractable representation of the Koopman operator via kernel-based extended dynamic mode decomposition (kEDMD). Deterministic error bounds are derived for the learned predictor, decomposing the total error into contributions from history discretization, kernel interpolation, and data-driven regression. translated_title: 关于非线性延迟微分方程的数据驱动Koopman表示
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.03086v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：本工作建立了无限维延迟动力学与有限维Koopman学习之间的严格桥梁，并提供了明确且可解释的误差保证。虽然Koopman分析在常微分方程（ODE）中发展成熟，在偏微分方程（PDE）中也有部分应用，但由于延迟微分方程（DDE）的无限维相空间，其扩展到DDE仍受到限制。我们提出了一种基于历史离散化和合适重构算子的有限维Koopman近似框架，通过基于核的扩展动态模式分解（kEDMD）实现了Koopman算子的可处理表示。为学习到的预测器推导了确定性误差界，将总误差分解为历史离散化、核插值和数据驱动回归的贡献。此外，我们还开发了一种基于核的重构方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于历史离散化和核方法的有限维Koopman近似框架，为非线性延迟微分方程提供了可解释的误差保证和高效的数据驱动表示。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a finite-dimensional Koopman approximation framework based on history discretization and kernel methods, providing interpretable error guarantees and efficient data-driven representations for nonlinear delay differential equations.
